== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rebel Aces (Errata)]] (<code>1271_45</code>, Virtual Block 7.1 slip 45), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-02-Rebel_Aces.png]], [[:File:VB7-p8-47-I_ll_Take_The_Leader.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-rebelaces-pre.gif]]) show the original text of [[Rebel Aces]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2013-01-11], Internet Archive). The card list drops icons; the icons are those of the printed slip. Typo kept as published (“capacit”).
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. Your Sandwhirl is canceled. At battleground systems where you have a Rebel of ability = 2 piloting a starfighter, and you have no Force drain bonus (except from the system card itself), your Force drains are +1. Your starfighters with a pilot character aboard are immune to attrition < 4. Once per turn, may ▼ Close Air Support. Your Rebel starfighters without astromech capacit (except Falcon or Artoo-Detoo In Red 5) gain "May add 1 astromech."”
* '''Made:''' 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 72) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (<code>1271_45</code>: Decipher art, Mission frame, title, Virtual Block 7 set mark, slip number 45, original-title strip) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. The Mission template does not draw the banner's [Setup] icon or the left-margin disc; both were added to the render (the [Setup] icon from the CardMaker icon set, the disc from the Players Committee card image).
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
